dialogues.speaker: Popocani
dialogues.text: Huh? Didn't you come here after receiving an invitation from the resort? Uhm, okay, let me give you a brief overview...

dialogues.speaker: Popocani
dialogues.text: The Easybreeze Holiday Resort is a large summer resort located on the coast and divided into several different regions. It was decided to build the resort here in Tenochtzitoc, in the far west of Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Popocani
dialogues.text: Now, all you need to do is walk that way along the beach to get to the reception. Make sure to pick up your commemorative album from the resort. After that, you're free to enjoy your holiday.
